At the top the ball stops for an instant: v = 0. Watch the velocity arrow shrink to nothing on the way up.

No time is given, so use the equation without t, with v = 0 at the top and a = −g:

0=v02−2gh→h=v022g0 = v_0^2 - 2gh \\quad\\rightarrow\\quad h = \\frac{v_0^2}{2g}0=v02​−2gh→h=2gv02​​

Put in the numbers:

h=(29.4)22×9.80=44.1 mh = \\frac{(29.4)^2}{2 \\times 9.80} = 44.1\\ \\text{m}h=2×9.80(29.4)2​=44.1 m

Height goes as the square of the launch speed: three times the speed, nine times the height. The 9.80 m/s throw tops out at 4.90 m.
